description: This file contains unit tests for the DhcpPacFileFetcherWin class and related components, testing DHCP PAC file fetching logic on Windows, including various scenarios like cancellation, timeouts, multiple adapters, and reuse.

classes.name: RealFetchTester
classes.description: Helper class to test real DHCP PAC file fetching, including cancellation and deferred cancellation scenarios.

classes.name: DummyDhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher
classes.description: Mock fetcher simulating DHCP PAC file fetches with configurable results and delays.

classes.name: MockDhcpPacFileFetcherWin
classes.description: Mock implementation of DhcpPacFileFetcherWin for testing, with controllable adapter fetchers and adapter query.

classes.name: FetcherClient
classes.description: Client class to run fetch tests, handle completion, and manage fetcher state.

methods.name: RunTest
methods.description: Initiates a fetch operation and sets up completion callback.

methods.name: RunTestWithDeferredCancel
methods.description: Runs fetch with a delayed cancel to test deferred cancellation.

methods.name: FinishTestAllowCleanup
methods.description: Allows worker threads to finish, with a sleep delay.

methods.name: ResetTestState
methods.description: Resets client and fetcher state for reuse.
